findings_fixed: Light-theme accent contrast: clay (articles ~3.4:1), ochre (reviews ~3.2:1) and gold metadata (~3.2:1) failed WCAG AA for small labels/links/chips. Darkened to AA on both paper tones (clay #9c4d34 = 5.20/4.75, ochre+gold #7a6122 = 5.14/4.70). Oxblood and taupe already passed; all dark-theme accents already pass.

Heading hierarchy on section index pages: emitted two <h1> (front-page nameplate + section name). Added a BaseLayout 'section' variant that keeps the full-width nameplate visual but renders it as a <div>, so the section name is the sole <h1>.

Heading hierarchy on post/newsletter pages: issues use `#` as in-issue section headers, producing up to nine <h1>. Added src/plugins/remark-demote-headings.ts (content `#`->h2, capped at h6) so the post title is the only <h1>.
Focus visibility: links use color:inherit so keyboard focus was invisible. Added a global :focus-visible outline (2px accent, offset) in both themes.
Added a skip-to-content link to <main id="main"> (visually hidden until focused).
Reduced motion: added a prefers-reduced-motion:reduce block neutralising the short colour/background transitions.
color-scheme set to light/dark so native form controls and scrollbars follow the theme.
Touch targets: footer link vertical padding bumped (~22px -> ~27px tall) to clear the 24px minimum.
Added @astrojs/sitemap integration (site https://edition.rodmachen.com); dist/sitemap-index.xml now emitted.

findings_waived.reason: It is a meta-refresh redirect stub, not a content page.

findings_waived.finding: Newsletter post bodies skip from h2 to h4
findings_waived.reason: Source content authors `#` then `###` (skipping `##`); the demotion preserves that skip. Rewriting per-issue heading semantics is content editing, out of scope for a polish pass. The critical multiple-h1 issue is resolved.

findings_waived.finding: Editorial nav links and the Day/Night theme toggle are below the 44px ideal touch target
findings_waived.reason: All are >=24px (toggle 32px min-height); the dense broadsheet nav would be visually distorted by 44px targets. WIG minimum (24px) is met.

findings_waived.reason: Pre-existing CI config, unrelated to Step 11 scope; only a non-blocking deprecation warning.

decisions: Fixed contrast by darkening accent tokens within the same hue family rather than recolouring, preserving the Ledger Broadsheet identity; large display headings keep their warm tone and still clear 3:1.

Decoupled nameplate heading semantics from its full-width visual via a new 'section' BaseLayout variant (headingNameplate prop on Header) instead of demoting the section <h1>, keeping the section name as the page's primary heading.
Chose a repo-wide remark heading-demotion plugin over editing 11+ markdown files; pure heading-level shift, lowest-risk way to guarantee a single <h1> per post.
Confirmed (no change needed): RSS feed hrefs use plural section paths; OG + Twitter card meta present on post pages with Cloudinary OG images; fonts already load with display=swap and preconnect.
